warnings: A row of 4 three-storey shophouse units: x = grids 1-5 at 4.00 (16.00); y = Thai-lettered rows printed top-to-bottom จ, ง, ค, ข, ก (4.00/4.00/4.00/2.50). Origin = top-left จ1. Same grid as the 2-storey set (house 71) — and here all three sheets agree on จ→ง = 4.00.
จ'' (≈1.10, bathroom beam B1 in bay จ-ง) is scaled and flagged; the matching beam in bay ง-ค sits on the printed 1.50 tick (ง').
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget).

2026-10-23 (op04 finish): dimension chains of S-04 (ชั้นลอย), S-05 (ชั้น 2), S-06 (ชั้น 3) and S-07 (คานหลังคา) added; every printed tick on them is a line (rule 4). x 2.75 (B3/B5 line, S-03) and x 2.80 (end of the 0.50 S3A landing-slab tick on S-05) are 0.05 apart and kept as two lines.

S-05 prints the 1.20/1.10/1.70, 0.50 and 0.90/2.20/0.90 sub-chains in bay 1-2 only; the identical (mirrored) units in bays 2-3, 3-4, 4-5 carry no printed sub-dimensions, so no lines were created there — their off-grid beams are recorded with the missing line named, never mirrored into a position.
op_fix/gridfix: x tick at 2.8 is within 0.05 m of existing ["1'"] but not the same point -- kept both (section 4 rule 4)

op_fix/gridfix 2026-09-29: dummy primes re-sequenced into reading order (spec section 4 Dummy grid) -- 1' -> 1'''', จ'' -> จ''''; grid refs in every file of the house follow; prose in older warnings still uses the old names
